public_definitions: The goal is to review the telehealth follow-up demand dashboard and select the operational route that best fits the overall request pattern for this record.
The dashboard is the evidence source for selecting the appropriate telehealth follow-up demand route.
The three operational routes are: 'Route the record to growth-response follow-up', 'Route the record to decline-response follow-up', and 'Route the record to standard monitoring follow-up'.
